overview.description: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk is an Indonesia-based company engaged in the exploration, exploitation, and power production of geothermal energy across Indonesia.

news.title: Pertamina Geothermal Energy Allocates $350 Million Capex for Lumut Balai Unit 2 Expansion
news.summary: PGEO continues green expansion with 55 MW Lumut Balai Unit 2 geothermal power plant, targeting commercial operation in 2024 to increase clean energy dispatch.

news.title: PGEO Signs Geothermal Co-generation Agreement to Cut Carbon Emissions
news.summary: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy signed secondary fluid heat exchange agreement reducing operational GHG intensity below 80g CO2e/kWh.
